description: STEEL-3dPointClouds: 3D-point cloud database for supporting automated quantification of residual life and reusability of steel beam-columns is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Tianyu Gu, Swiss Federal Institute of Technology In Lausanne (epfl.ch). This repository presents the STEEL-3dPointClouds, a large-scale database of deformed steel beam-column members obtained using high-fidelity physics-based numerical simulations. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 3 top-level files (PDF, HDF5). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-1deq-4z12. Keywords: steel beam-column, numerical simulation, point cloud, reserve capacity, cyclic loading, inelastic buckling. Published 2024-11-20. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
